title: Human-AI Organizations, Delegation, and Accountability
subtitle: Consequential delegation requires a versioned organizational contract binding charter, affected parties, actors, roles, competence… conflicts, incentives, benefits, escalation, appeal, remedy, contribution, dependence, accountability, succession, dissolution, and residual custody.
next_title: Human-AI Symbiosis, Neurotechnology, and Cognitive Sovereignty

display.problem: Repeated human-AI work changes decision rights, information, skill, workload, incentives… typed task or generic human-in-the-loop label cannot govern.
display.insufficient: A human signature, model accuracy, role title, task reward… meaningful control, legitimate authority, accountability, worker welfare, or organizational resilience.

mechanism.label: Charter purpose mandate affected
mechanism.detail: Charter purpose, mandate, affected parties, prohibited ends, lifespan, and owners.

mechanism.label: Register human AI team
mechanism.detail: Register human, AI, team, and institutional actors with competence, training, workload, accessibility, and conflicts.

mechanism.label: Proposal advice decision execution
mechanism.detail: Map proposal, advice, decision, execution, review, stop… notice rights for each decision class.

mechanism.label: Bound delegation depth duration
mechanism.detail: Bound delegation depth, duration, subdelegation, automation, replacement, and revocation.

proof_targets: A finite organizational record refuses accountability assignment… competence, time, or intervention authority is absent.

AI evaluation cannot be its own independent approval
